{{Quote|I was told Major Cobus was cool and calm under pressure.|A spacer|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Cobus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] his forces on [[Asation]] were [[Raid on Asation|attacked]] by the creatures coming through the [[Grand Hypergate]] that was opened by [[Kephess]], servant of the [[Dread Masters]]. [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] Gatemaster [[Beltek'k]] tried to explain Cobus the situation, but Major had a better success with representatives sent by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]. Cobus informed the arrivals about Kephess's involvement and provided the shuttle to fly the strike team to Asation. Cobus later thanked those involved after the situation was brought under control.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Cobus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the introductory cutscene for the "Terror From Beyond" operation on Republic side.
